title: The relative gluing axioms hold at the selected stage
statement:
In $\mathsf R_{X,\lambda_{\mathrm{rel}}}$ the overlap opens match in both
directions, the overlap maps are inverse, and all triple-overlap cocycle
identities hold.

Apply [lemma-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound] with the fixed pair-bound operation and its bound proof to obtain the inequality to lambda_rel. proof.text: Apply [lemma-nagata-qc-open-eq-eventually] to each indexed open choice at lambda_rel, and [lemma-nagata-morphism-eq-eventually] to each indexed map choice at the same stage. Convert from list indices to arbitrary members using List.mem_iff_get. This proves equality for every entry of the two explicit relation lists.

proof.text: Expand finite-list membership to select diagonal coverage, reversed-orientation coverage, forward domain matching, inverse identities, forward and backward intersection agreement, orientation agreement, diagonal identity, and the triple cocycle. Inverse images commute with arbitrary unions; the canonical first projection commutes with each Over.pullback map, giving forward domain matching. Functoriality gives inverse identities and the diagonal identity. The pullback-preservation comparison isomorphism transports each intersection equation. For the triple equation, use the inner comparison isomorphism and an outer pullback lift; precompose the transported raw equation with this lift and simplify its projections. Finally pull the forward domain equality back along the backward map; the backward-forward inverse identity reduces it to backward domain matching. Assemble the ten clauses of HasGluingAxioms.
